long_biography.plain_text:
R20 is the investment office through which Robert Tchenguiz advises assets held for his branch of the family trust. Its remit has ranged across public and private equity, structured finance and real estate. Trustees retain formal ownership and decision-making authority, while Tchenguiz acts through the advisory company as beneficiary, protector and investment adviser.

Technology has provided one durable part of that work. R20 financed the construction-software company Asite during its development, and Tchenguiz later became chairman. He remains a director of Asite businesses, which operate cloud platforms for the built environment and connect teams working across construction and infrastructure projects.

British nationality and England residence are identity-verified through Companies House, and Tehran is strongly established as birthplace. Iranian citizenship is not established, so no secondary-nationality proposal is made.
